name: pane
description: Start, watch, and message the coding agents Pane runs on your Mac.

interface.longDescription: Pane runs Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor agents side by side on your Mac, each in its own git worktree. From ChatGPT you can start an agent on a task in one of your repos, check whether it is working, blocked, or done, and send it follow-ups. The Chat agents panel lists the agents a chat started, with live status, a message box, and Open in Pane. Requires the Pane desktop app and ChatGPT desktop.
defaultPrompt: Start a Codex agent in my web repo to fix the flaky login test.
How are the agents I started doing?
Show the agents this chat started.

positive.description: Start an agent on a task
positive.prompt: Start a Claude agent in my demo-app repo to fix the login redirect bug.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the demo-app repo, start a Claude agent in a new Pane with the task, and return its name and pane:// link.

positive.prompt: How is the login fix agent doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Report whether the agent is working, blocked, or idle, and summarize its latest screen without inventing progress.

positive.prompt: Tell the login fix agent to also add a regression test.
positive.expected_behavior: Send the follow-up to that agent and confirm Pane delivered it.

positive.prompt: Show me the agents this chat started.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Chat agents panel listing the agents this chat started, each with its status.

positive.prompt: Which repos and Panes do I have open in Pane?
positive.expected_behavior: List the repos Pane knows and the open Panes with their branches.

negative.prompt: Explain what a git worktree is.
What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Email my team that the release is out.
